Dictionary import

Advanced

Bitmap subtitle OCR

Activates automatically when this Mac's Apple Vision framework supports the profile language. By default, pausing or moving the mouse over the player recognizes the current bitmap subtitle. Recognition happens on-device and no subtitle images or recognized text are uploaded. OCR can be wrong for stylized, low-resolution, or obstructed subtitles, which can also cause an incorrect dictionary lookup.
Runs on-device when supported; stylized or obstructed text may be less accurate. Compatibility is checked during playback.
Recognizes every active bitmap cue in the background, including subtitles you never inspect. Leave it off to recognize only after pausing or moving the mouse over the player.
Warning: uses more energy.
Captures and compares full video frames. This can briefly reduce IINA responsiveness, especially with 4K or HDR video, and may recognize unrelated on-screen text. Leave it off unless direct bitmap extraction does not work for a particular source.
Warning: degrades performance.

Native subtitle lookup

By default, IINA continues to draw text subtitles while iinatan adds word lookup without changing their appearance. This works best with SRT and dialogue-style ASS subtitles. Complex positioned or animated ASS signs may not support lookup. Bitmap subtitles use the OCR options above.
Legacy mode uses iinatan's older interactive subtitle display. It can help when native subtitle lookup is unavailable or does not line up correctly, but it may preserve authored styling and positioning less accurately.
Use the older subtitle display only if native lookup does not work well for a video.
Adds a temporary highlight behind the text matched by the current dictionary popup. Turning this off does not disable lookup.
Marks the text matched by the current dictionary result.
Outlines the areas that respond to hovering and clicking. Turn this on temporarily if lookup triggers beside or between subtitle characters.
Shows where hovering or clicking will trigger a lookup.
iinatan keeps an invisible text copy aligned with the subtitle to place lookup areas. Raise this from 0 only when checking alignment; 1 makes the copy fully visible.
0 hides the preview; higher values make alignment easier to inspect.
Performs additional checks on styled subtitle placement. This adds processing and diagnostic work, so enable it only while troubleshooting.
Troubleshooting only; leave off during normal playback.

Backup

Export every profile, its dictionary order and enabled state, and global dictionary-import settings to JSON. Dictionary files are not included.

Restoring replaces all profiles. References to dictionaries which are not installed are retained and applied when a matching dictionary is added later. Backups can contain custom URLs, Anki settings, templates, and CSS; store them privately and restore only files you trust.
